sections.heading: Request account deletion
paragraphs: You can request deletion of your ClearFix account and its associated personal data in the app or by email. You do not need to reinstall or open the app to send an email request.

bullets.label: In the app
bullets.body: Open Profile, select Edit Profile, and choose Delete account. Follow the instructions shown in ClearFix.

bullets.label: By email
bullets.body: Email [clearfix.ca@gmail.com](mailto:clearfix.ca@gmail.com?subject=ClearFix%20account%20deletion) and state that you want your ClearFix account deleted. Identify the account concerned, for example by its account email address.

bullets.label: Account ownership
bullets.body: We may request information reasonably needed to verify your identity and authority. Do not send passwords, full card numbers, card security codes, or unnecessary identity documents.

sections.heading: Data removed with the account
paragraphs: Account deletion is processed on the server in stages. Cleanup removes your user profile, account files, settings, and the orders you created as a customer, including their ordinary photos and records. Finalized financial records follow the retention rules below. A limited reference to a deleted order can remain in another participant’s public order history, including its title, outcome, dates, closure reasons and comments, and an indication that the order is unavailable, subject to the shared-history limits in the Privacy Policy.

If you participated in another customer's order, shared business history may remain for the other participant, service integrity, disputes, accounting, security, or legal purposes, only to the extent and for as long as reasonably necessary or legally required. Cleanup removes account-profile details from the participant snapshots it processes and marks the account as deleted. This does not erase personal information you entered in messages, comments, accepted terms, or supporting documents, or necessarily remove internal account identifiers needed to link retained records. Retained history is therefore not necessarily anonymous. Existing ordinary conversations with a deleted participant become read-only, and applicable access restrictions continue to apply.

Self-service deletion requires recent authentication and can be paused by active orders, including saved drafts and orders assigned to you, unresolved financial settlements or disputes, outstanding balances, or a seven-day hold after order closure. These technical conditions do not override your rights under applicable law. If a condition prevents self-service deletion, contact the email address above about your request.

sections.heading: Records retained and retention periods
paragraphs: Finalized settlements, commission payments, invoices, receipts, refunds, chargebacks, tax records, and supporting financial records are retained for at least six years from the end of the last tax year to which they relate. A longer period may apply when required by law, an unresolved dispute, an audit, a legal hold, or a valid government requirement.

Limited consent, moderation, privacy-request, and response records may remain when reasonably necessary for compliance, safety, or a claim. Mandatory retention periods, including those protecting access to information used to make a decision about you, take precedence. Where PIPEDA applies, records of breaches of security safeguards are kept for at least 24 months after the day we determine that the breach occurred. Shared service history retained for other participants follows the ongoing service-history purposes and limitations described in the Privacy Policy. Retained business and legal records are access-restricted and are not used to restore the deleted account.

Sentry diagnostic events and ordinary Google Cloud application logs are retained for up to 30 days. Google's required audit and system log bucket retains its logs for 400 days. Scheduled Firestore backups, if enabled, are retained for no more than 30 days. Support mailbox records are retained for up to 24 months after a request is closed, unless a longer business or legal retention rule applies.

sections.heading: Privacy information and contact
paragraphs: Read the [ClearFix Privacy Policy](https://www.clearfix.click/privacy_policy.html) for the full deletion, retention, external-service, and privacy-rights information. Send questions or difficulties with a deletion request to [clearfix.ca@gmail.com](mailto:clearfix.ca@gmail.com).
